notes.title: Invest and Return
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/fbc17bde4560e8c147b64f0dadd3540d95177ea0.png[/img]
It's time to increase your deposits, a great event that will allow you to increase your real gold coins supply.
There are 5 investment packages, choose one of them, make a deposit and get the first return immediately, the next return of real gold coins - 
on the 2nd day
on the 4th day
on the 8th day

For example: after investing 1000 coins, the total profit after 8 days will be 1100.
* During the event, every player can only take part in Invest and Return once. 
* Return rewards will be sent via mail in corresponding days
*The invested amount must be fully invested before 00:00 of the current day.
[i]For example: If you make a recharge of 500 gold coins today, make another 500 gold coins after 00:00, and try to invest 1000 gold coins, it will not work.[/i]
*Within one day, you need to recharge 1000 coins and invest until 00:00 on the server day.
*Cannot invest from current balance; all invested gold coins must be recharge.

[i]Best regards, JTGGame Team![/i]

It's time to increase your deposits, a great event that will allow you to increase your real gold coins supply.
There are 5 investment packages, choose one of them, make a deposit and get the first return immediately, the next return of real gold coins - 
on the 2nd day
on the 4th day
on the 8th day

For example: after investing 1000 coins, the total profit after 8 days will be 1100.
* During the event, every player can only take part in Invest and Return once. 
* Return rewards will be sent via mail in corresponding days
*The invested amount must be fully invested before 00:00 of the current day.
[i]For example: If you make a recharge of 500 gold coins today, make another 500 gold coins after 00:00, and try to invest 1000 gold coins, it will not work.[/i]
*Within one day, you need to recharge 1000 coins and invest until 00:00 on the server day.
*Cannot invest from current balance; all invested gold coins must be recharge.

[i]Best regards, JTGGame Team![/i]

on the 2nd day
on the 4th day
on the 8th day

For example: after investing 1000 coins, the total profit after 8 days will be 1100.
* During the event, every player can only take part in Invest and Return once. 
* Return rewards will be sent via mail in corresponding days
*The invested amount must be fully invested before 00:00 of the current day.
[i]For example: If you make a recharge of 500 gold coins today, make another 500 gold coins after 00:00, and try to invest 1000 gold coins, it will not work.[/i]
*Within one day, you need to recharge 1000 coins and invest until 00:00 on the server day.
*Cannot invest from current balance; all invested gold coins must be recharge.

[i]Best regards, JTGGame Team![/i]

notes.title: Invest and Return
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/fbc17bde4560e8c147b64f0dadd3540d95177ea0.png[/img]
It's time to increase your deposits, a great event that will allow you to increase your real gold coins supply.
There are 5 investment packages, choose one of them, make a deposit and get the first return immediately, the next return of real gold coins - 
on the 2nd day
on the 4th day
on the 8th day

For example: after investing 1000 coins, the total profit after 8 days will be 1100.
* During the event, every player can only take part in Invest and Return once. 
* Return rewards will be sent via mail in corresponding days
*The invested amount must be fully invested before 00:00 of the current day.
[i]For example: If you make a recharge of 500 gold coins today, make another 500 gold coins after 00:00, and try to invest 1000 gold coins, it will not work.[/i]
*Within one day, you need to recharge 1000 coins and invest until 00:00 on the server day.
*Cannot invest from current balance; all invested gold coins must be recharge.

[i]Best regards, JTGGame Team![/i]

notes.title: Invest and Return
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/fbc17bde4560e8c147b64f0dadd3540d95177ea0.png[/img]
It's time to increase your deposits, a great event that will allow you to increase your real gold coins supply.
There are 5 investment packages, choose one of them, make a deposit and get the first return immediately, the next return of real gold coins - 
on the 2nd day
on the 4th day
on the 8th day

For example: after investing 1000 coins, the total profit after 8 days will be 1100.
* During the event, every player can only take part in Invest and Return once. 
* Return rewards will be sent via mail in corresponding days
*The invested amount must be fully invested before 00:00 of the current day.
[i]For example: If you make a recharge of 500 gold coins today, make another 500 gold coins after 00:00, and try to invest 1000 gold coins, it will not work.[/i]
*Within one day, you need to recharge 1000 coins and invest until 00:00 on the server day.
*Cannot invest from current balance; all invested gold coins must be recharge.

[i]Best regards, JTGGame Team![/i]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/fbc17bde4560e8c147b64f0dadd3540d95177ea0.png[/img]
It's time to increase your deposits, a great event that will allow you to increase your real gold coins supply.
There are 5 investment packages, choose one of them, make a deposit and get the first return immediately, the next return of real gold coins - 
on the 2nd day
on the 4th day
on the 8th day

For example: after investing 1000 coins, the total profit after 8 days will be 1100.
* During the event, every player can only take part in Invest and Return once. 
* Return rewards will be sent via mail in corresponding days
*The invested amount must be fully invested before 00:00 of the current day.
[i]For example: If you make a recharge of 500 gold coins today, make another 500 gold coins after 00:00, and try to invest 1000 gold coins, it will not work.[/i]
*Within one day, you need to recharge 1000 coins and invest until 00:00 on the server day.
*Cannot invest from current balance; all invested gold coins must be recharge.

[i]Best regards, JTGGame Team![/i]

on the 2nd day
on the 4th day
on the 8th day

*Cannot invest from current balance; all invested gold coins must be recharge.

notes.title: Score Exchange
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/c96558ebc189b0fc0507ebc118dd58cf61b92a7e.png[/img]

A great event that will allow you to get points for the spent gold coins, which can be exchanged for excellent items.
[b]Features of this event[/b]
[list]
[*] If Score Exchange is launched in parallel with Lucky Draw, then 1 spent gold coin is equal to 2 points.
[*] These accumulated points can be used both in the Score Exchange event itself and in the Lucky Draw event ([i]points spent are displayed exactly in both events and if spend points in Score Exchange, they will disappear from the Lucky Draw event and vice versa.[/i])
[*] [b]IMPORTANT![/b] If the points are not spent by the end of this event, the points can be reset to zero if one of the related events - ends (Lucky Draw or Score Exchange)
[/list]


[list]
[*] [b]The current launch of the event does not include the parallel start of the Lucky Draw event, therefore 1 coin spent = 1 points.
[*]The number of exchange points for items in the event has been reduced.[/b]
[/list]



[i]Best regards JTGgame Team![/i]

notes.title: Invest and Return
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/fbc17bde4560e8c147b64f0dadd3540d95177ea0.png[/img]
It's time to increase your deposits, a great event that will allow you to increase your real gold coins supply.
There are 5 investment packages, choose one of them, make a deposit and get the first return immediately, the next return of real gold coins - 
on the 2nd day
on the 4th day
on the 8th day

For example: after investing 1000 coins, the total profit after 8 days will be 1100.
* During the event, every player can only take part in Invest and Return once. 
* Return rewards will be sent via mail in corresponding days
*The invested amount must be fully invested before 00:00 of the current day.
[i]For example: If you make a recharge of 500 gold coins today, make another 500 gold coins after 00:00, and try to invest 1000 gold coins, it will not work.[/i]
*Within one day, you need to recharge 1000 coins and invest until 00:00 on the server day.
*Cannot invest from current balance; all invested gold coins must be recharge.

[i]Best regards, JTGGame Team![/i]

notes.notes:
Dear's
We present to your attention an event that has been launched, so that each player has a chance to get more bonuses to all other bonuses that can be obtained when recharging.

[i]Bring to your attention the following:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/8c07fe04d20dbac4687520137fdb0f2943c40429.png[/img]

notes.title: Score Exchange
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/c96558ebc189b0fc0507ebc118dd58cf61b92a7e.png[/img]

A great event that will allow you to get points for the spent gold coins, which can be exchanged for excellent items.
[b]Features of this event[/b]
[list]
[*] If Score Exchange is launched in parallel with Lucky Draw, then 1 spent gold coin is equal to 2 points.
[*] These accumulated points can be used both in the Score Exchange event itself and in the Lucky Draw event ([i]points spent are displayed exactly in both events and if spend points in Score Exchange, they will disappear from the Lucky Draw event and vice versa.[/i])
[*] [b]IMPORTANT![/b] If the points are not spent by the end of this event, the points can be reset to zero if one of the related events - ends (Lucky Draw or Score Exchange)
[/list]


[list]
[*] [b]The current launch of the event does not include the parallel start of the Lucky Draw event, therefore 1 coin spent = 1 points.
[*]The number of exchange points for items in the event has been reduced.[/b]
[/list]



[i]Best regards JTGgame Team![/i]

notes.title: Invest and Return
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/fbc17bde4560e8c147b64f0dadd3540d95177ea0.png[/img]
It's time to increase your deposits, a great event that will allow you to increase your real gold coins supply.
There are 5 investment packages, choose one of them, make a deposit and get the first return immediately, the next return of real gold coins - 
on the 2nd day
on the 4th day
on the 8th day

For example: after investing 1000 coins, the total profit after 8 days will be 1100.
* During the event, every player can only take part in Invest and Return once. 
* Return rewards will be sent via mail in corresponding days
*The invested amount must be fully invested before 00:00 of the current day.
[i]For example: If you make a recharge of 500 gold coins today, make another 500 gold coins after 00:00, and try to invest 1000 gold coins, it will not work.[/i]
*Within one day, you need to recharge 1000 coins and invest until 00:00 on the server day.
*Cannot invest from current balance; all invested gold coins must be recharge.

[i]Best regards, JTGGame Team![/i]

notes.title: Invest and Return
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/fbc17bde4560e8c147b64f0dadd3540d95177ea0.png[/img]
It's time to increase your deposits, a great event that will allow you to increase your real gold coins supply.
There are 5 investment packages, choose one of them, make a deposit and get the first return immediately, the next return of real gold coins - 
on the 2nd day
on the 4th day
on the 8th day

For example: after investing 1000 coins, the total profit after 8 days will be 1100.
* During the event, every player can only take part in Invest and Return once. 
* Return rewards will be sent via mail in corresponding days
*The invested amount must be fully invested before 00:00 of the current day.
[i]For example: If you make a recharge of 500 gold coins today, make another 500 gold coins after 00:00, and try to invest 1000 gold coins, it will not work.[/i]
*Within one day, you need to recharge 1000 coins and invest until 00:00 on the server day.
*Cannot invest from current balance; all invested gold coins must be recharge.

[i]Best regards, JTGGame Team![/i]

notes.title: Temporary gold
notes.notes:
Limited-time gold

In this topic we will find out what it is and why.
There are two types of gold in our game, this is gold that you can buy with money, also get in events - let's call it real gold coins.

and there is also gold, which is limited in time of use, such gold coins CANNOT be bought for real money, they can only be obtained through events: Gold joy, Accumulate Recharge, Limit-time Gold, Daily Cumulate Recharge, Gold Slote Machine, Improvement Joy, and also some items contain such coins, when opened you will receive these temporary coins.

These two coins are displayed as one number on the balance, BUT temporary coins are also displayed separately.
Like this: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/17c306c4beeb210ec1511af7071454f9447db4ac.jpg[/img]

After receiving such coins, it is enough to update the game.
The consumption of such coins is not displayed in Gold Joy, and they cannot be used in the Flash Sale. Also, when purchasing, for example: ready-made equipment in Fuse, temporary coins will be spent, if the total of these coins is not enough, real coins will also be spent.


If you have temporary gold coins, then when you spend in these places, these coins will be spent first:

1) Slots for expanding the unit warehouse
2) Slots for expanding the equipment warehouse
3) Slots for expanding your skill set
4) Slots for expanding the material warehouse
5) Slots for expanding the officer warehouse
6) Slots for expanding the medal warehouse
7)Purchasing equipment from the Fuse
8) Spent on purchasing contract to update officers in the store
9) Spent on purchasing skills in the store
10) Spent on purchasing materials in the store
11) Spent on speeding up training, BP production, collecting silver
12) Spent on collecting additional silver tax
13) Spent on gold contributions to the corps
14) Spent on strengthening the hull in the BC
15) Spent in resource exchange (black market)
16) Spent on acquiring attempts at companies, battle zone etc.
17) To improve equipment with gold.
And so on.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/456ea22f54c576f728b1cc5d9bb2b1f11adfc3b3.jpg[/img]


[i]Best regards,JTGGame Team[/i]

on the 2nd day
on the 4th day
on the 8th day

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/fbc17bde4560e8c147b64f0dadd3540d95177ea0.png[/img]
It's time to increase your deposits, a great event that will allow you to increase your real gold coins supply.
There are 5 investment packages, choose one of them, make a deposit and get the first return immediately, the next return of real gold coins - 
on the 2nd day
on the 4th day
on the 8th day

For example: after investing 1000 coins, the total profit after 8 days will be 1100.
* During the event, every player can only take part in Invest and Return once. 
* Return rewards will be sent via mail in corresponding days
*The invested amount must be fully invested before 00:00 of the current day.
[i]For example: If you make a recharge of 500 gold coins today, make another 500 gold coins after 00:00, and try to invest 1000 gold coins, it will not work.[/i]
*Within one day, you need to recharge 1000 coins and invest until 00:00 on the server day.
*Cannot invest from current balance; all invested gold coins must be recharge.

[i]Best regards, JTGGame Team![/i]

notes.title: *NEW! Let's change the unit type
notes.notes:
Enough time has passed since the start of the great battle and now it’s time to reconsider your strategy.

[b]We give the opportunity to change one unit to another (of the same type) :[/b]

[b]For example:[/b]
[i]If you previously had a Phantom type 130 tank, you can now change to the B23 Heavy Hit Tank type 130.[/i]
That is, this action provides an opportunity to reconsider your squad.

Exchanges can only be made by unit type.
Infantry to Infantry
Tank to Tank
Artillery to Artillery

unit type:
130 to 130 - for 2099 gold
150 to 150 - for 3999 gold
170 to 170 - for 4999 gold

[list]
[*] During the exchange, the unit must not have equipment or an officer.
[*] The unit must be empty, as in the picture:
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/fa485c1cbc02f1d7a4b64124344735f2614400f0.jpg[/img]
[list][*]In a warehouse, an object should not contain a lock.[/list]

[b]With this exchange:[/b] [i]automatic inheritance/transfer of the increased unit level, as well as improvement and camouflage parameters from the old unit to the new one occurs.[/i]

[b][u]If the squad has an officer or equipment, then you can lose these things.[/u][/b]

Leave it in the comments: the exact name of the old unit and the exact name of the unit you want to switch to.

We will compile the list until : 19/Nov/2023.



Thank you for choosing us and playing our game. Best regards, JTGGame team!

notes.title: Increasing Unit Type
notes.notes:
Enough time has passed since the great battle began and now it’s time to become even stronger.

[list]
[*] We ask each player who wants to increase their unit to the next type to write in the comments the exact name of the unit and the type that needs increased.
[*] You can request 1 or more units for exchange.
[/list]
[i]For example:[/i]
I have a unit in my squad: Mars-130 (type130) would like to exchange for Mars-150 (type150)

*We will arrange the exchange using Trade-in.
*You cannot exchange the type of one unit for the type of another unit:
[i][u]For example: Mars-130 cannot be exchanged for Phantom-150.[/u][/i]

Leave a comment and we will help you make the exchange.


[h2][b]Comments will be collected until 2023/9/18.
[/b][/h2]



Thank you for choosing us and playing our game. Best regards, JTGGame Team!

notes.title: Score Exchange
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/c96558ebc189b0fc0507ebc118dd58cf61b92a7e.png[/img]

A great event that will allow you to get points for the spent gold coins, which can be exchanged for excellent items.
[b]Features of this event[/b]
[list]
[*] If Score Exchange is launched in parallel with Lucky Draw, then 1 spent gold coin is equal to 2 points.
[*] These accumulated points can be used both in the Score Exchange event itself and in the Lucky Draw event ([i]points spent are displayed exactly in both events and if spend points in Score Exchange, they will disappear from the Lucky Draw event and vice versa.[/i])
[*] [b]IMPORTANT![/b] If the points are not spent by the end of this event, the points can be reset to zero if one of the related events - ends (Lucky Draw or Score Exchange)
[/list]


[list]
[*] [b]The current launch of the event does not include the parallel start of the Lucky Draw event, therefore 1 coin spent = 1 points.
[*]The number of exchange points for items in the event has been reduced.[/b]
[/list]



[i]Best regards JTGgame Team![/i]

notes.title: Top Trade-in
notes.notes:
A festive event that will allow you to get unique festive troops, you just have to collect the necessary ingredients for the exchange.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/ffd65b9e462d362f6bf728892cb6b9dd182be95b.jpg[/img]

Let's reveal the secret:
You need Dogtag II
You can get Dogtag II in special instances
The Battle of Medenine and [ACE]Battle of Medenine 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/42a4b042a96cf2f75ac536b5135ab5e3c3ebbedd.jpg[/img]
These instances are divided into two types, regular and elite, which need a Instance Ticket, in such instaces you have a better chance of getting more Dogtag II.
You need Easter Bag Card([i]in Trade-in - exchange Dog Tag II and get Easter Bag Card[/i])[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/2032ed2cc0226a944b5c76a80cafb38700694ed5.jpg[/img]

[b]Get tank: Aura  Heavy Tank

Unit skill: 
[u]Invincible[/u]
The skill is triggered on the first move of the unit, and becomes invulnerable to enemy attacks in the current and next round.[/b]


[b]Important:[/b] When the *[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1367720/announcements/detail/3691314738470201831]Good to go[/url]* event is triggered, you will receive more items from instances.

Complete all requirements exchange and receive rewards.


Best regards, JTGGame Team!

notes.title: Reinforcement
notes.notes:
Dear users

Let's talk about the [b]Reinforcement function[/b]
This function is auxiliary and is used during battles in instances/camp
Details :
The function becomes available after level 120+. To activate this function, [b]need to open Construct
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/7029a26fba8a52e94a38ad787e3ec7b1ee4f82f6.jpg[/img]
Where in the upper right corner we open the Reinforcement function itself and get to the page with the activation of cells for units. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/a0b4fdb24f81d20f10eb1bdbc02af949e2e7d0d2.jpg[/img]

To activate these cells need [b]Strategy Books[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/358d6bd527178dfcd0e412532310a98cce06c5dc.jpg[/img]

And so after activating these cells, need to select units for these cells.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/3eeee4213e4051e78d4e48b65ed776a5e80b9570.jpg[/img]
And so we installed the units in these cells.

For the function to work, you must have a Reinfocement Order in stock [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/e45973db5af28fc6542989e75925a72dae9582c7.jpg[/img] (pay attention to the description of these orders, since there are two types of them: for camp and for instances), these scrolls will be automatically used during the battle when one of the main units is lost. ([b]do not put lock in stock for these items[/b])

Resultat:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/044cccb142a3f65c33896b7d7064ba1b3a2ad416.jpg[/img]
We lost one main unit, the game offered us to add a unit from Reinforcement, we approved this by clicking on OK and the unit was delivered to the battlefield.



[i]Best regards, JTGGame Team[/i]

notes.title: Reinforcement
notes.notes:
Dear users

Let's talk about the [b]Reinforcement function[/b]
This function is auxiliary and is used during battles in instances/camp
Details :
The function becomes available after level 120+. To activate this function, [b]need to open Construct
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/7029a26fba8a52e94a38ad787e3ec7b1ee4f82f6.jpg[/img]
Where in the upper right corner we open the Reinforcement function itself and get to the page with the activation of cells for units. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/a0b4fdb24f81d20f10eb1bdbc02af949e2e7d0d2.jpg[/img]

To activate these cells need [b]Strategy Books[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/358d6bd527178dfcd0e412532310a98cce06c5dc.jpg[/img]

And so after activating these cells, need to select units for these cells.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/3eeee4213e4051e78d4e48b65ed776a5e80b9570.jpg[/img]
And so we installed the units in these cells.

For the function to work, you must have a Reinfocement Order in stock [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/e45973db5af28fc6542989e75925a72dae9582c7.jpg[/img] (pay attention to the description of these orders, since there are two types of them: for camp and for instances), these scrolls will be automatically used during the battle when one of the main units is lost. ([b]do not put lock in stock for these items[/b])

Resultat:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/044cccb142a3f65c33896b7d7064ba1b3a2ad416.jpg[/img]
We lost one main unit, the game offered us to add a unit from Reinforcement, we approved this by clicking on OK and the unit was delivered to the battlefield.



[i]Best regards, JTGGame Team[/i]

notes.notes:

Best regards, JTGGame Team!

We present to your attention a new event that has been launched, so that each player has a chance to get more bonuses to all other bonuses that can be obtained when recharging.

notes.title: Reinforcement
notes.notes:
Dear users

Let's talk about the [b]Reinforcement function[/b]
This function is auxiliary and is used during battles in instances/camp
Details :
The function becomes available after level 120+. To activate this function, [b]need to open Construct
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/7029a26fba8a52e94a38ad787e3ec7b1ee4f82f6.jpg[/img]
Where in the upper right corner we open the Reinforcement function itself and get to the page with the activation of cells for units. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/a0b4fdb24f81d20f10eb1bdbc02af949e2e7d0d2.jpg[/img]

To activate these cells need [b]Strategy Books[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/358d6bd527178dfcd0e412532310a98cce06c5dc.jpg[/img]

And so after activating these cells, need to select units for these cells.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/3eeee4213e4051e78d4e48b65ed776a5e80b9570.jpg[/img]
And so we installed the units in these cells.

For the function to work, you must have a Reinfocement Order in stock [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/e45973db5af28fc6542989e75925a72dae9582c7.jpg[/img] (pay attention to the description of these orders, since there are two types of them: for camp and for instances), these scrolls will be automatically used during the battle when one of the main units is lost. ([b]do not put lock in stock for these items[/b])

Resultat:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/044cccb142a3f65c33896b7d7064ba1b3a2ad416.jpg[/img]
We lost one main unit, the game offered us to add a unit from Reinforcement, we approved this by clicking on OK and the unit was delivered to the battlefield.



[i]Best regards, JTGGame Team[/i]

notes.title: R-Medal Collection
notes.notes:
Dear's
We present to your attention a new event that has been launched, so that each player has a chance to get more bonuses to all other bonuses that can be obtained when recharging.

[i]Bring to your attention the following:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/8c07fe04d20dbac4687520137fdb0f2943c40429.png[/img]
[b]The event starts for a period of one month, when you recharge, a mark appears on the event in the form (R-Medal)[/b]

[b]and as soon as a sufficient number of R-medals accumulate, you will receive additional time-limited gold coins to your in-game mail.[/b]

notes.title: Dears
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/bfca34e1d2e5d5301837d1456b5584222c8bc32f.jpg[/img]
Dear players!
Due to the fact that we have added support for the Japanese language to our game, it is possible that some players may experience some difficulties after updating the game client, but do not worry.
For instance :
You cannot go back to your servers in the English version - all you need to do is right-click on General War Memories in the game center, select properties and change the game language, or simply delete the game from the Steam launcher and download it again.

If you have any problems, please let us know.
You can do this both through discussions and by writing in private messages, we are always happy to help you.


[i]Best regards, JTGGame Team![/i]

notes.title: New language
notes.notes:
Dear users!
We are constantly working to make our game more comfortable for you, our favorite players, and we do it with joy.
In recent days, we have received many requests for the game to have multiple language support.
Therefore, we started by saying that our game supports the [u][b]Japanese language as of today[/b][/u].

[b][i]We come back soon[/i][/b]

notes.title: R-Medal Collection
notes.notes:
Dear's
We present to your attention a new event that has been launched, so that each player has a chance to get more bonuses to all other bonuses that can be obtained when recharging.

[i]Bring to your attention the following:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/8c07fe04d20dbac4687520137fdb0f2943c40429.png[/img]
[b]The event starts for a period of one month, when you recharge, a mark appears on the event in the form (R-Medal)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/b7253b9f48c7f8ec37f5cb8a59f1892580f01090.png[/img]
[b]and as soon as a sufficient number of R-medals accumulate, you will receive additional time-limited gold coins to your in-game mail.[/b]

[i]For example:[/i]
[b]If you recharge 7 days in a row for 100 gold coins, can immediately get the first reward +400 temporary gold coins.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38325447/dd0eb5b640adb8886cd74122b9349c16887e901f.png[/img]
